title: <repo>/.agentic-workflow/repo.json
description: Repo facts that two or more skills read: bug-fix, ship and the UI proof skills. Every key is optional; a skill keeps its current behaviour for a missing one.

variants.description: The product variants a behaviour change must be checked on.

axis.description: What varies, e.g. plan, locale, tenant-type.

baseline.description: True on the reference variant (what it did before). At most one.

dataRepair.description: How rows a bug damaged are repaired.

never.description: Ways that are forbidden, e.g. a raw SQL file.

environments.description: Ordered names, e.g. local, preview, staging, prod.

reviewBots.description: Bot logins whose PR comments are fixed or answered.

prePush.description: Cheap commands that must pass before a push. `<changed>` stands for the changed files.

skipReviewLoop.description: PR kinds that skip the review loop, e.g. revert.

siblingSurfaces.description: Used to find screens next to a changed one.
